This document outlines critical initiatives for enhancing operational efficiency:

*   Optimize teller performance urgently.
*   Optimize cash flow standard updates.
*   Investigate branch efficiency based on audit findings.
*   Monitor customer wait time for Strategy 2026.
*   Monitor cash flow standard updates.
